$comment: Bilingual curation layer for the generated repository catalogue.
src/data/repos.generated.json is machine-owned — a scheduled workflow rewrites
it and hand edits there are lost. This file is human-owned: it is the only
place where a title, summary, audience or type is written by hand, and it is
Keys are repo names from the generated data. Every entry should carry:
type      app | report | ebook | dataset | source   (what it is)
audiences farmer | officer | policy | learning     (who it is for; one or more)
titleEn / titleBn    display name (falls back to the GitHub 'homepage' title)
summaryEn / summaryBn  one line for cards, search and previews
notesEn / notesBn    optional longer paragraph shown on the detail page
An unknown key is ignored at build time; a missing key falls back to the
generated description with type 'app' and no audience. Nothing here can break
the site, and nothing here changes any count: numbers stay computed.

portfolio.notesEn: A static GitHub Pages site. Repository listings are generated from the GitHub dashboard by a scheduled workflow, so the catalogue cannot drift from what is actually published.
